requirements: All contenders must share one lock for balance
Locks A/B must not admit circular wait
Published initialized payload must be visible
Filesystem guard and read must address same object
Every continuously ready worker eventually runs
Each strategy invocation must use its own requested discount: A requests 0.5 and B requests 0. Calls may overlap; latest-writer-wins shared configuration is not permitted for this per-call strategy.

balance.lock: one mutex owned by shared balance

flow: each call passes immutable discount argument

retry.two_workers: deterministic ordered admission grants one worker progress
